# Step 2.159: a game's page tells the truth in every state

## Builder 1 (the one truth and the game's own page)

**What exists.** `publicGameState(facts, { now, today })` in `packages/core/src/modules/games/public-game-state.ts` (exported from `@srleagues/core`): one public state, `upcoming`, `awaiting-score`, `live`, `being-corrected`, `final`, `forfeit`, `postponed`, `cancelled`, with the result shown and `endedAt` (T-382). Facts: status, `startsAt`, `localDate` (a day with no time), scores, `finalizedAt`, `beingCorrected`. While a reopen is open the result is the latest correction's `before` (T-383): core's `resultBeingCorrected`, the store port `GamesReadStore.resultBeingCorrected` (query `find-game-result-being-corrected.ts`), and `GamePage.game.beingCorrected`. Every reopen counts, the scorekeeper's own too; "Take back End game" writes no correction, so it is untouched. Standings unchanged: only final games count (S-101, decided for you). Spec P7 §5.3 and §5.5 corrected; pending rows T-382, T-383, T-384, S-101. No migration.

**The game's page** (`build-game.ts`: `gameTruthOf`, `truthLine`, `truthPill`): awaiting score has the pill "Awaiting score", "Was set for Saturday, November 14 at 10:00 AM", "No score has been entered yet." and no day on the board; a forfeit says "Was set for …" with no box scores; a final says "Ended Saturday, November 14" (the day it ended, league's zone; "Was set for …" when the end is not known); being corrected holds the board at the result as it stood, pill "Being corrected", no plays or box score, drawn again only once final again (`held` on `LiveGameView`, `redrawsWhileHeld`, T-384); a player who did not play reads "Did not play" (`note` on the UI's `BoxScorePlayer`). `game.wasSetFor` now reads "Was set for {when}" (postponed and cancelled too).

**Run and passed.** `npm run typecheck`, `npm run check`; vitest: `public-game-state.test.ts` (14, seen failing: no module), `corrected-mark.test.ts` (the four new, seen failing), `packages/database/src/stores/public-reads.test.ts` (the new store test of a reopen by hand against the real store, with another league reading nothing), `apps/web/src/features/live-game` (87 + 1). The page tests were written after the page code: not seen failing first. Pending-decisions test passed.

**Builder 2 must do.**

1. Home page (`schedule-pages/build-schedule.ts`, `home-lists.ts`, `home-page.tsx`): replace the `awaiting` sum in `gameView` with `publicGameState` (pass `localDate`, the clock's `now` and `today`). "Waiting for a score" is its own short list apart from "Upcoming games"; a game with no result is never under "Recent results" (today `home-lists.ts` mixes them). The quiet word "Awaiting result" becomes the pill "Awaiting score" (`game.awaitingScore`); retire `schedule.awaitingResult` if nothing else uses it.
2. Being corrected on the lists: `PublicGame` (`packages/core/src/modules/scheduling/public-schedule.ts`) does not carry `beingCorrected` yet. Add it to the public games read (`list-public-games` in `packages/database`, the stand-in in `apps/web/src/server/stand-in-world-reads.ts` beside `resultBeingCorrected`), show the result as it stood with "Being corrected", and run `node scripts/fence-filter-check.mjs` and the role matrix if the read changes.
3. Schedule and a team's page (`team-pages/build-team.ts`): the same truth and order; an awaiting game is not listed under "Schedule" after a later one.
4. The game's own page reads no `localDate` (the schedule's one-game facts do not carry it): a game with a day and no time reads upcoming on its page after its day. Add `localDate` to `PublicGameFacts` in `apps/web/src/server/public-schedule.ts` and its two readers, then pass it to `gameTruthOf`.
5. A browser test at 390 wide with a controlled clock of every state on every page (the plan line's done test), the laptop holes of the plan line if cheap, the T-81 scan, page-step checks.

**What I distrust.** A by-hand correction ending: whether a live message reaches a held page so it redraws (a tracked one does through the snapshot); a parent may need to reload. The `.ui-box-note` cell has no style of its own yet. A start exactly now already reads "Awaiting score" (kept from the old rule, T-382).

## Builder 2 (the lists, and what builder 1 left)

**What exists.** `gameTruth` and `hasResult` (`schedule-pages/build-schedule.ts`) put `publicGameState` behind every list: `GameView` gains `pill` ("Awaiting score", "Being corrected") and `held`. Home page: "Waiting for a score" is its own section (two at most, `data-awaiting-list`); "Upcoming games" holds only upcoming and live; "Recent results" (and the standings page's latest results) only final, forfeit and being corrected; `homeResults` no longer takes waiting games. Schedule: the same list over the rounds (`ScheduleView.awaiting`), each game still in its round with the pill. Team page: `TeamGames.awaiting`, its own section; the Schedule list no longer holds a passed game after a later one. `PublicGame.beingCorrected` comes from `list-public-games.ts` (one more query of corrections, `resultsAsTheyStood`) and the stand-in; a held card ignores the correction's live taps and drops its pill when final again (`applyUpdate`). `GameCard` takes `pill` (`data-kind='truth'`, the board's soft tint). Link words say "being corrected" and "awaiting the score". The game's page reads `localDate` (`PublicGameFacts`, `find-public-game-facts.ts`). `shownParts(state)` decides box scores and plays. The "Did not play" cell is in the quiet text color (DESIGN.md line 112's rule for quiet figures). DESIGN.md line 106 and P7 §5.3 corrected; pending T-385 and S-102.

**A page open while a by-hand correction ends.** It learns by its snapshot, fetched every 30 s (5 to 60 s by state) while the game is not final (`follow-game.ts`). A by-hand end saves no play, so the snapshot comes back final at the same sequence; `redrawsWhileHeld` now redraws on a final snapshot no older than the page (T-385). Not done: `redraw-page.ts` reloads at most once per sequence number, so a page that was already redrawn at that number when the game was reopened would not reload again. A parent may need to reload then.

## Builder 3 (the browser test, the fence, the redraw)

**What exists.** `tests/browser/game-states-test.mjs` (390 wide, the world's clock at the league's noon, signed out): upcoming, awaiting score, live, final, forfeit, postponed, cancelled (cancelled here by the owner's taps), being corrected by the owner and after the scorekeeper's own reopen (both by taps in Games, then ended again with a new score). For each, the game's page and every card of it on the home page, the schedule and its home team's page give the same state word and score; the schedule must list it, the team's page too (a cancelled game is left off a team's page, `build-team.ts`). "Waiting for a score" holds only awaiting games, none under "The next matchups" or a team's "Schedule"; "Recent results" and a team's "Results" only games with a score; an awaiting page says "No score has been entered yet." and never "has not started yet"; a forfeit page has no "Box scores" or "Played"; a final page says "Ended". Cards found by their link to the game, lists by `data-awaiting-list` or their heading.

**Fence.** The corrections query is now one file, `list-results-being-corrected.ts` (many games at once), read by `list-public-games.ts` and by `gamesReadStore.resultBeingCorrected`; `find-game-result-being-corrected.ts` is gone (it had no filter of its own left). Its two isolation cases reopen the TARGET's final game (live, a correction whose before is a forfeit 20 to 0, timed after the seed's own correction, which is stamped by the real clock: that was why builder 2's case read nothing in the control). `node scripts/fence-filter-check.mjs list-results-being-corrected list-public-games games-read-store`: 2 filters caught, 0 problems.

**Redraw.** `redraw-page.ts` remembers the sequence number AND status it reloaded for (`status` option, passed by `live-game-view.tsx`): a page redrawn when a game was reopened is drawn again when it is ended by hand at the same number; a stale page still cannot loop. Unit test seen failing first (1 failed), then 89 passed in live-game. T-386 pending.

## Independent review (fixes nothing)

**Medium.**

1. One truth broken on the home page's number strip: `schedule-pages/build-home-numbers.ts` lines 8, 9, 18 and 28 count "games played" and "to play" by the game's raw status. A game awaiting its score counts as "to play", and a game being corrected (status live or scheduled) counts as "to play", not "played", while the same page lists it under "Waiting for a score" or "Recent results" with its score. To see it: reopen a final game in Games, then open the home page.
2. S-101 reads S-47 correctly: "unchanged (S-11)" means the rule is unchanged, and S-11 counts only final games. But what a parent sees contradicts itself: the home page and the standings page list the game under latest results with its old score marked "Being corrected", while the table beside it leaves the game out, so both teams show one game fewer. A team's record does the same. No words explain this. The lead should choose between adding a line under the table and counting the result as it stood (S-101's own alternative). This is the founder's question when S-101 is read.
3. `game-states-test` never does the reopen the plan line names from step 2.37, a scorekeeper's own reopen of a TRACKED game on the scoring screen. `byScorekeeper` is a typed score reopened through "Correct this result". The test also never tries "Take back End game", reopen then end then reopen again, or the standings page. It does not check in a browser that a page being corrected hides its plays and box score. These are covered by unit tests only.

**Low.**

1. The `localDate` part of `publicGameState` (`public-game-state.ts` line 98) never runs. `localDate` is worked out from `starts_at` (`list-public-games.ts` line 57, `find-public-game-facts.ts`), so no game has a day without a time. A game with no time in a round whose date has passed reads "upcoming" for ever.
2. In `game-states-test` (lines 336 to 352) the expected live, final and forfeit scores are read from the game's own page and compared with the cards. A wrong score shown on every page would pass. Only the being-corrected cases fix the score in the test (50-44, 47-51).
3. A card in "Waiting for a score" that goes live through the channel (`live-game-list.tsx`) says "Live" but stays in that list until the page is reloaded. `home-lists.ts` line 20 still has a status rule of its own. It agrees today only because its input was filtered first.
4. The public snapshot and the live channel still carry the correction's running score while the page says "Being corrected". Pages ignore it, but the JSON can be read. This was already so before this step.
5. A correction whose `before` has no scores (rows older than step 2.229) makes the game read Live or Awaiting score, not Being corrected. There is no such data today.

**Holds.** Every page asks `gameTruth`/`gameTruthOf`, except item M1. The old words appear only behind the truth.

- Edges, in 8 throwaway checks, all as expected: a start exactly now reads awaiting; no date reads upcoming; reopen, change, end, reopen shows the latest final; a put back then a reopen; "Take back End game" after a reopen; a forfeit reopened to scheduled shows the forfeit "Being corrected". The time zone is safe because the time comparison is made on exact instants.
- Privacy: "Did not play" uses the same `boxScoreName` and `playerLinesShown`, and the new query returns scores only.
- Isolation: with the league filter of `list-results-being-corrected.ts` deleted by hand, the cases of `gamesReadStore` (1 leak) and `listResultsBeingCorrected` (2 leaks) fail. The `listPublicGames` case still passes, because it does not reach the query. The file was restored with `git checkout`.

**Broken by hand, then restored.** The home page with awaiting games put among its results was caught by "'Recent results' holds only games with a result". A forfeit offered box scores was caught by "a forfeit's page has no 'Box scores'".

**More of the browser chain, all passed.** demo-hidden-numbers (232 checks), public-pencil (13), score-this-game (105), sheet-put-back (30), demo-league-on-database (322), games-area (38), publish-preview (20), scoring-screen (1002).
